C17_formal_condition: (U1′)  F(Γ(X_n)) = Λ(F(X_n)) for every state X_n on the Kleene sequence of Γ. Then Theorem T2 yields F(μΓ) = μΛ. This is the precise guarantee; it is weaker than global (U1).
C19_verdict: H1 (sufficiency of ε-tolerant finite-index recoverability for any K constant on filter-indistinguishable pairs) is a theorem (definitional). H1+ (necessity of the declared CRA structure (~_C, φ, ε=0.5) for recovering an arbitrary agency-like predicate on the whole of P(U)) is FALSE: K_act = 1_{act:indexical ∈ X} differs on a filter-indistinguishable pair, and so does cardinality parity after deleting M0:observable (distance 1/3 ≤ 0.5). On Fix(Γ_C), K_act holds if and only if M3 is active, hence factors through ~_C. T6 (H1+ᶜ) is this conditional theorem.
C20_theorem: T7. Let D be a set and K : D → {0,1}. There exists a proper (injective and not surjective) self-map e : D → D with K ∘ e = K if and only if some fibre K⁻¹(i) is infinite. Identity always works and is never proper. Every finite agency-supporting carrier (in particular each three-atom finite stratum of the CRA demo) therefore admits no proper K-preserving self-embedding.
C21_mc_note: Monte Carlo under H0 (p=1/2) to calibrate the z-test; not experimental intention data.
C21_status: OPEN CONJECTURE — instrumented, zero trials collected in this edition
C21_stopping: Fixed n = 144000; no optional stopping. If a group-sequential analysis is later added it must be pre-registered with an alpha-spending function (O’Brien–Fleming).
C21_primary: Two-sided test of H0: p = 1/2 against H1: |p − 1/2| ≥ 0.0037 (or the computed MDB). Test statistic z = (2K − n)/√n; reject H0 at |z| > z_{1−α/2}. Report the exact binomial p-value as well, the point estimate, and a 95% CI.
C22_island_formula: S(R) = min_I ext_I [ Area(∂I)/(4 G_N) + S_matter(R ∪ I) ]
C22_conjecture: Unitary-evaporation conjecture (strong form): the joint state of an evaporating black hole and its Hawking radiation, in a complete quantum theory of gravity, is (approximately) pure at all times if the initial state is pure; equivalently, the fine-grained entropy of the radiation follows a Page curve, returning to zero at complete evaporation.
C22_status: OPEN CONJECTURE — not settled by replica-wormhole calculations in toy models, nor by this Doctrine
C22_would_settle: A derivation of the Page curve (or of information-preserving evaporation) for realistic four-dimensional, asymptotically flat (or de Sitter) black holes from a complete quantum gravity; or a no-go theorem ruling unitary evaporation out; or a decisive observational signature. Reproduction of a Page curve in two-dimensional JT gravity via replica wormholes and the island formula is necessary-style evidence in a toy model, not a settlement.
